description:
FILED s523a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20) from #3282's measurement.  The TAP layer (cl/pcl-test.lisp's END hook) never sets Test::Builder's EXIT STATUS, and two of its end messages differ from perl.  A DESIGN QUESTION, not taken: every runner keys on the status (see below).

PROBED (scratch/s523a/pr/doq/, `run.sh -q FILE` = perl / 8038fac6 base / tree; perl 5.40.3's Test::More):
  f2    plan 3, 2 fail          perl "# Looks like you failed 2 tests of 3." rc 2     PCL no line, rc 0
  f1m   plan 5, ran 2, 1 fail   perl planned-line + "# Looks like you failed 1 test of 2 run." rc 1    PCL planned-line only, rc 0
  extra plan 1, ran 2           perl "# Looks like you planned 1 test but ran 2." rc 255   PCL "1 tests", rc 0
  dtf   done_testing, 1 fail    perl failed-line rc 1     PCL rc 0
  zero  plan 3, ran 0           perl "# No tests run!" rc 255    PCL "planned 3 tests but ran 0." rc 0
  die   die after 1 of 3        perl "dead" + "# Looks like your test exited with 255 just after 1." rc 255   PCL planned-line + runpcl's Lisp-shaped "While evaluating the form..." rc 255
  endq  END { $? = 7 }          perl "...exited with 7 just after 1." rc 7   PCL planned-line rc 7
  ex3   exit 3 after all        perl "...exited with 3 just after 2." rc 3   PCL rc 3
  ok / none / skip / dt         identical (rc 0)
Test::Builder's rule: a non-zero $? on entry is kept and announced ("exited with N just after M"); else failures -> rc min(F,254) with the failed-line; else planned != ran -> rc 255; ran 0 with a plan -> "No tests run!" rc 255.

WHY NOT SHIPPED: (1) tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl classifies any non-zero SBCL exit as CRASH and refines PCL-INCOMPLETE by it -- every perl-tests file with a failing row would flip OK -> CRASH unless the status is Test::More-only (perl's t/test.pl does NOT set the status the same way -- check before deciding); (2) tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl's shortfall text carries the rc ("ran M of N, rc R") and a non-zero rc makes a full-plan file with failures grow a *PLAN* row -- a board-wide re-key of the blessed rows; (3) cl/pcl-test.lisp is the HARNESS row of WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN (companion --all --quick per batch).  Decide: Test::More-only status + runner adjustments, or keep rc 0 and fix only the message text.
The rule-12 half that DID ship (s523a member 2): tools/run-dist-t.pl shows the stream + stderr when a run stops short of its plan, not only when a row failed.


=== DONE (s523c, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20) ===
Commits dec9e92f (the TAP ending + the runners) and a421430c (seven board *PLAN* rows, rc text) on the s523c branch.
cl/pcl-test.lisp's END runs Test::Builder::_ending when a Test::Builder module was used (*p-test-builder-used*, set by p-ensure-test-lib in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp -- PROCESS-wide, as Test::Builder's END is): failures -> min(F,254) "# Looks like you failed F test(s) of N[ run]."; planned != ran -> 255 "# Looks like you planned N test(s) but ran M."; plan + 0 rows -> 255 "# No tests run!"; rows, no plan -> "# Tests were run but no plan was declared and done_testing() was not seen." + failures / 254; a non-zero ENTRY status ($?, or SBCL's exit-in-progress code for an unhandled host error) kept and announced "# Looks like your test exited with N just after M." / "before it could output anything."; skip_all / BAIL_OUT: nothing more (*test-ended-early*); skip_all writes "1..0 # SKIP why" (Test::More) vs "# Skip" (t/test.pl).  A t/test.pl run keeps that harness's ending (no status) and prints the PCL fact line "# PCL-EXIT status=N after=M" for a non-zero entry status.
Runners: tools/lib/PCLTap.pm test_builder_exit + exit_is_verdict (+ parse_tap's `failed`); tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl CRASH only when the exit is not the verdict; tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows' SBCL line gains a 4th field (verdict); tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl's shortfall treats a verdict exit as clean.  run-perl-suite.pl keys only on 124 (timeout) -- unchanged; everyday has no Test::More program; prove's own exit status is that of the real-perl Pl/t files -- unchanged.
Probes (scratch/s523c/pr/tb, 26 shapes perl vs tree): every rc identical except `plan skip_all` AFTER a plan (perl croaks "You tried to plan twice", rc 255; PCL prints 1..0 and exits 0 -- pre-existing, not filed).  Guard Pl/t/tap-exit-01.t 42 rows (27 FAIL on 6cf75804); Pl/t/tap-assert-01.t's six whole-output rows gain perl's closing line; tools/t/cpan-scoreboard.t +9 PCLTap rows (its other 8 failing rows fail identically on 6cf75804).  docs/tap-assertion-audit.md "The exit status"; runbook §4.


=== s523c (s524 resume): the branch was rebased twice (MAIN-READY-40 notes, then MAIN-READY-41); the commit names above are PRE-rebase.  Current: de092299 (the TAP ending + runners), 36d78257 (seven board *PLAN* rows), 65411c51 (the t/test.pl fact line only after the TAP layer was used).  Bars at s524: gate PASS 329 / 11,236 on MAIN-READY-40 (re-taken on -41, see the MERGE-READY report); sweep TOTAL 18,758 clean, _status.tsv file by file = the BEFORE sweep but ref.t 200 (s522b); companion --all --quick: no verdict moved by the exit status, ROW DIFF 0/0/0.
subject: DESIGN: the TAP layer never sets Test::Builder exit status (failures -> F, short plan -> 255) and says "planned N but ran 0" where perl says "No tests run!" -- runners (sweep CRASH, board shortfall rc) key on it
